words.gloss: even if I think of him

literal: If I forget, what will I become? Alas! Forgetting I do not know; even if I think of him, my heart burns.
translation: If I were to forget him, what would become of me? But alas, I do not even know how to forget! And yet, even when I merely think of him, my heart burns.
modern: அவரை நான் மறந்தால் எனக்கு என்ன நேரிடும்? ஆனால் எனக்கு மறக்கவே தெரியாது; அவரை நினைத்தாலும் என் நெஞ்சம் சுடுகிறது.
explanation: The heroine describes her helpless state of longing during separation. She wonders what would happen to her if she could forget her lover, but immediately admits that she does not even know how to forget him ('மறப்பு அறியேன்'). Ironically, even when she does not forget and merely thinks of him ('உள்ளினும்'), the memory is so intense that it burns her heart ('உள்ளம் சுடும்'). She is trapped in a state where neither forgetting is possible, nor is remembering comforting.
